_README: Articles and topics are filled in; `quote` is EMPTY until a human pastes the OFFICIAL text. The backend sends ONLY verified=true entries. The Labor Code was RENUMBERED (RA 10151 and DOLE Department Advisory No. 1, s. 2015): labels use the NEW number with the old one in brackets, e.g. Art. 296 [281]. Check both numbers against your source. Keep each quote (or its excerpt) under ~400 characters so two fit in Lumen's 2000-character message. NOTE: 13th-month pay is NOT in the Labor Code; it is Presidential Decree No. 851. The Labor Code's household-worker chapter was repealed by RA 10361, so kasambahay use ra10361.json, not this file.
source: Presidential Decree No. 442 (Labor Code of the Philippines), as amended and renumbered
covers: Private-sector employees in the Philippines. Not kasambahay (see ra10361.json), not OFWs (see ofw-ra8042.json).
